items.caption:
u have three signs, not one, and they are hardly ever the same.
the sun moves one degree a day. the moon thirteen. the rising sign changes a whole sign every two hours.
which is why a sun sign horoscope can be written for a twelfth of the planet, and ur rising sign cannot.
tag the friend whose rising sign explains absolutely everything.

items.caption:
two of ur nine grahas have no body, no light and no mass.
they are the two points where the moon's path crosses the sun's, which is the only place an eclipse can happen.
the old story says a demon was beheaded and the head keeps swallowing the sun. every detail of that is a correct statement about the lunar nodes.
one wants everything. one is already done. they sit in exactly opposite houses.

items.caption:
mercury has never moved backwards. not once, not ever.
it orbits in 88 days and laps us every 116, and around that pass our line of sight to it runs backwards against the stars.
it happens three times a year, for about 18 percent of the calendar, for every person alive at the same time.
and vedic astrology scores a retrograde graha as strong. vakri gains cheshta bala. that is the opposite of what u have been told.

dhanteras is on 6 november. mercury is retrograde from 24 october to 13 november. so is diwali.
dhanteras is a muhurat. mercury retrograde is a transit. two different branches, and one was never built to override the other.
and u cannot move dhanteras anyway. it is a tithi. so "postpone it" means skip the festival, and nobody means that.
buy the thing. check the warranty twice. save the bill. that's it, that's the whole remedy.
